ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Unit Expansion
ideas.description: Investigate the bill expanding Minnesota's Medicaid fraud unit and its potential impact on reducing fraud in the state's Medicaid system.
ideas.angle: The bill's effectiveness in combating Medicaid fraud
questions: What are the key provisions of the bill?
How will the expanded unit operate?
ideas.insight: The expansion of Minnesota's Medicaid fraud unit could have a significant impact on reducing fraud in the state's Medicaid system. Investigating the specifics of the bill and its implementation could provide valuable insights into effective strategies for combating fraud.

ideas.title: Feeding Our Future Fraudster's Mansion
ideas.description: Investigate the sale of the marble-filled mansion once owned by a Feeding Our Future fraudster for $2.1 million and its connection to the ongoing case.
ideas.angle: The mansion's sale and its ties to the Feeding Our Future case
questions: What are the details of the mansion's sale?
How does this relate to the ongoing Feeding Our Future investigation?
searches: Feeding Our Future fraudster mansion sale
ideas.insight: The sale of the mansion once owned by a Feeding Our Future fraudster raises questions about the case's status and the potential for recovering ill-gotten gains. Investigating the specifics of the sale and its connection to the ongoing case could provide valuable insights into the effectiveness of efforts to combat fraud.
